recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic portrait of a weathered human skull wearing a spiked leather face mask and a formal suit, set against a stark white background. The aesthetic blends gothic horror with modern dystopian fashion.
coreVisualRelationships: The skull serves as the primary organic texture against the clean geometric lines of the suit.
The metallic spikes on the mask create a sharp visual tension with the hollow eye sockets.
The stark white background isolates the subject, emphasizing its silhouette and textural detail.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic color palette with subtle purple accents.
Highly detailed bone texture with visible cracks and pitting.
Sharp, high-key lighting that creates deep shadows in the orbits and under the jaw.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally located, three-quarter profile view, filling the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, hollow eye sockets of the skull.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left logo, moves down to the skull's eyes, follows the curve of the mask to the bottom-right typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive pure white space surrounding the subject to enhance the 'floating' effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted violet/purple glow on the bottom-right typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with almost zero saturation, except for the localized purple glow.

letterConstructionRules: Top-left: Intricate, symmetrical blackletter with thorny, vine-like extensions.
Bottom-right: Blocky, wide-set futuristic characters with inner glows and sharp cutouts.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top logo are intertwined with sharp, calligraphic flourishes.
Bottom characters feature horizontal segments and a metallic gradient fill.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between medieval calligraphic complexity and modern industrial minimalism.

preserve: The thorny nature of the top logo
The wide, blocky nature of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the gothic aesthetic of the top logo.
Matches the blocky, futuristic feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photorealistic human skull in three-quarter profile, wearing a black leather face mask with silver spikes and a white collared shirt with a black suit jacket. The lighting should be harsh and high-contrast against a pure white background. The skull should have a weathered, ancient texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a complex, thorny blackletter logo in the top left corner. Add a bold, wide futuristic title in the bottom right corner with a purple metallic gradient and a soft outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the skull texture highly detailed?
Are the spikes on the mask sharp and metallic?
Does the bottom text have a purple glow?

mustRedesign: Exact letterforms of the artist name

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the suit and mask

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical accuracy of the skull.
Ensure the mask conforms to the skull's structure.
Verify the contrast between the black suit and white background is crisp.
Confirm the typography does not overlap the main subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a macabre organic subject (skull) with modern industrial accessories (spiked mask) and formal wear (suit) in a high-contrast monochromatic environment, framed by opposing typographic styles (Gothic vs. Futuristic).
